title: Quintessential Earthy Korean Lentils Dosirak
description: A traditional Korean dish from Busan featuring earthy lentils and namul, perfect for a date night, shojin-friendly and served in a dosirak format.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
In a large pot, combine the soaked lentils and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger.
Add the soy sauce mixture to the cooked lentils and stir to combine.
Add the spinach to the lentils and cook until wilted.
Season the lentils with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the lentils to a dosirak container and garnish with sesame seeds.
Serve the dosirak hot, garnished with additional spinach if desired.
